title: Rey Mysterio and Psicosis bring lucha libre to ECW
summary: Established opponents from Mexico introduce ECW’s crowd to a different kind of rivalry. Their speed and aerial counters expand the promotion’s range beyond its best-known brawls.

chapters.title: Rey wins their ECW debut encounter
chapters.context: The match gives the ECW audience a prominent introduction to the two luchadores.

chapters.title: The Mexican Death match
chapters.result: Mysterio defeats Psicosis in the stipulation rematch.
chapters.context: The familiar aerial rivalry adapts to an ECW-style endurance contest.
